summary: Lu Ziyuan was once a child who was addicted to video games, performed poorly in school, had no special talents, and left parents and teachers shaking their heads in frustration. During middle school, in an attempt to get attention from his peers, he began showcasing himself—yet with limited resources in his environment, he was forced to embark on a path of self-directed learning. Without formal instruction, he mastered visual effects and eventually became a top-tier VFX artist. He attended a vocational high school specializing in printing, and by his second year, he had already founded SIXVFX, an online platform for VFX education. Skilled in photo editing, animation production, and 3D modeling, he began building an online presence in his third year of high school, sharing a large volume of video content. Determined to gain admission to a national university through recommendation, he found ways to produce a substantial portfolio of video projects, despite having no access to school equipment or resources. He successfully created a unique learning portfolio and was admitted to National Yunlin University of Science and Technology. There, he continued to self-learn and master advanced technical skills in 3D effects and programming. After graduating from university, he launched his own business—and by the age of 25, he had become an entrepreneur with annual revenues in the eight-figure range

title: The complete turtletrader : the legend, the lessons, the results
author: Covel, Michael
summary: This is the true story behind Wall Street legend Richard Dennis, his disciples, the Turtles, and the trading techniques that made them millionaires. Dennis made a fortune on Wall Street by investing according to a few simple rules. Convinced that great trading was a skill that could be taught to anyone, he made a bet with his partner and ran a classified ad looking for novices. His recruits had anything but traditional Wall Street backgrounds. For two weeks, Dennis taught them his investment rules and philosophy, and set them loose to start trading, each with a million dollars of Dennis's money. By the time the experiment ended, Dennis had made $100 million and created a Wall Street legend. Here, author Covel tells their story, describes how Dennis interviewed and selected his students, details their education and experiences while working for him, and breaks down the Turtle system and rules in full.--From publisher description

BUSY is divided into four digestible sections -- Mastery, Differentiation, Engagement and Momentum -- that will teach readers how to switch from managing time to managing attention, how to transition toward a career strategy that doesn't hinge on productivity, how to think differently about success by re-engaging with what matters, and how to create the impetus, energy, and clarity to put all these changes into effect. Crabbe draws on entertaining psychological studies to show why we're getting it wrong at the moment and to develop a fresh new approach to taking back one's life from chaotic outside forces. Rarely has a book been more timely in both its scope and in its immediate impact. "--
